facts.business: Amarjothi Spinning Mills Limited is engaged in the manufacturing of yarn, processing of fabrics, and generation of wind power for captive consumption.
key_risks: Regulatory compliance risks (SEBI fines in 2024 and 2025)
facts.related_party_note: All related party transactions were entered into on arm's length basis in the ordinary course of business. No materially significant related party transactions with potential conflict of interest. Details provided in notes to financial statements.
